title.zh: 商业名称注册（第 17（1）（d）条下的指示）公告 2015
title.en: Business Names Registration (Direction under section 17(1)(d)) Notification 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Business Names Registration (Direction under section 17(1)(d)) Notification 2015.

2.—(1) The Minister directs that, subject to sub-paragraph (2), the Registrar must not accept for registration the word “Temasek” in any registered business name.
(2) Sub-paragraph (1) does not apply if the person applying to be registered as carrying on business, whether as a sole proprietor or as a partner, under the business name is Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act 1967 (Registration No. 197401143C).
